name: Bergström Sofa
description: A generous 3-seat sofa upholstered in durable linen fabric with solid oak legs. Removable cushion covers. Available in 6 colours: Natural, Slate, Sage, Blush, Charcoal, and Navy.

name: Lunde Armchair
description: A compact accent chair with solid oak legs and high-density foam seat. Perfect for reading corners. Upholstered in bouclé fabric.

name: Haug Coffee Table
description: Solid walnut top on a powder-coated steel frame. A simple, sculptural piece that anchors any living room. Lower shelf for magazines and books.

name: Eik Dining Table
description: An extendable dining table in solid oak seating 6 to 10 people. The extension leaves store neatly underneath the top when not in use.

name: Viken Dining Chair
description: A stackable dining chair with a sculpted plywood back and upholstered seat pad. Sold individually. Pairs perfectly with the Eik Dining Table.

name: Natt Bed Frame
description: A king-size bed frame in black lacquered solid wood with a low-profile headboard and slat base included. Fits standard 180 × 200 cm mattress.

name: Dønna Dresser
description: A 6-drawer dresser in white-oiled ash with soft-close drawer rails and solid brass handles. Ample storage with a clean, timeless silhouette.

name: Stille Bookshelf
description: A floor-to-ceiling shelf unit with adjustable shelf spacing. Wall-mounting hardware included. Available in natural oak or white lacquer finish.

name: Ro Lounge Chair
description: A fully upholstered lounge chair with a solid oak swivel base. Wide and deep seat for maximum comfort. Available in leather or fabric.
materials: Full-grain leather or fabric, solid oak

name: Fjord Side Table
description: A small round side table in solid marble top with a powder-coated steel leg. Lightweight and easy to move. Available in white and green marble.

name: Kveld Floor Lamp
description: An arched floor lamp with a solid concrete base and linen drum shade. Creates warm, diffused ambient light. Includes a dimmer switch on the cord.
dimensions: Base Ø 25 cm, H 175 cm, reach 60 cm
materials: Concrete base, steel arm, linen shade

name: Tre Desk
description: A solid oak writing desk with a single drawer and cable management hole. Clean legs with a subtle taper. A refined workspace for focused work.
